digest.component_or_area: CI/testing infrastructure, pytest performance, GitHub Actions workflow optimization
propositions: Every pytest phase ≥1.0s observed in selected CI runs and local exhaustive macOS census must be inventoried and classified by failure mode and coverage rationale, not duration alone.

Gerrit 1817 / 53efe2426e successfully removed 19 proven OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS/Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 while retaining them in Ubuntu 3.13, yielding ~8s macOS wall and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds without new jobs or setup overhead.

No individual pytest setup/call/teardown phase exceeded 30s in the three-run CI sample (max 22.63s) or the exhaustive local macOS census (max 15.62s default, 21.96s integration), so no long-pole test bloat is present.

Real external analyzers, Git locking/concurrency, partial-clone, import/packaging, signing/identity, and deploy/observability test suites provide unique failure modes and platform seams that cannot be safely removed, mocked, or routed without equivalence proof and tracker rejection search.

Test-owned deploybot window durations (songful-groovelike-horsemouse) and external analyzer coverage (lead-unpleasing-kitten) are approved next research directions; macOS-to-Ubuntu node routing faces rejectability by coercive-paediatric-bug due to prior 18.6→21.0m job and 22.3→25.2 burst contention regressions.
No further code, workflow, CI dispatch, test, or push modification is authorized under this audit; only tracker writebacks and closure are permitted.
